messages:
Lucy: Quick sync request - Concord wants a coordinated launch for their Gateway integration using our LlamaIndex adapter. Need timeline, owners, and a short checklist.
Concord PM: Hi all, wed like a joint blog + marketplace tile + a live demo at our webinar. Target week: 2024-09-16. Can your side do the integration sample?
Maria: We can handle marketplace copy and pricing blurb. Need final AO for the listing owner and assets (logo + 1-line).
Sanjay: Eng note: we can produce a reference adapter and a minimal sample app. Blocker is SSO metadata and the adapter contract (schema for calls).
Andrew: DevEx will produce quickstart and a 5-min demo script. Will want the sample payloads and a reproducible curl example.
Lucy: Key constraints: embargo date confirmation, legal sign-off, marketplace cadence, and a smoke-test window.
Eve (Legal): Please share the proposed joint statement and any feature claims. Also confirm there are no customer-identifying screenshots without consent.
Concord PM: Embargo sounds right: 2024-09-16 EOD. We'll provide logo + 40-80 word summary and approve messaging. No customer quotes for this launch.
Sanjay: Tech question: which model configs will the sample reference? If we mention quantized variants we should include perf caveats.
Maria: We'll default to our curated llama-13b-quant profile in the copy, with a note about alternative community models.
Andrew: Draft quickstart snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"adapter":"concord","input":"Summarize the doc"}'
```
Lucy: Can deploy-bot stand up a demo route for the rehearsals? Need a stable canary we can point slides at.
deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/concord-gateway-2024-09 (2x A100, retention 72h). Auth tokens enabled.
integrations-bot: Added Trello cards: ["SSO metadata & sandbox creds"], ["Adapter contract upload"], ["Quickstart guide draft"], ["Marketplace copy draft"], ["Legal messaging review"].
Maria: I'll own listing copy + marketplace submission. ETA to upload draft: 2024-08-20.
Sanjay: Eng tasks: adapter prototype by 2024-08-22 if we get API contract now. Compatibility matrix for model variants by 2024-09-06.
Andrew: Quickstart + sample app PR ready by 2024-08-25. Will include a local docker dev image.
Eve (Legal): I'll review copy and the joint messaging once Maria posts drafts. Also need confirmation on any performance numbers (latency/cost) we plan to publish.
Lucy: Proposed rehearsal schedule: dry run 2024-09-13, final rehearsal 2024-09-15. Webinar + publish 2024-09-16.
Concord PM: Confirmed. We'll handle webinar registration and will share slides 48h before final rehearsal.
Maria: Action list here: marketplace copy (me), confirm owner + submit listing (me), gather logos (Concord), coordinate slide assets (Marketing).
Sanjay: Action list: adapter proto (me), SSO test (Sanjay + Concord PM), compatibility doc (me).
Andrew: Action list: quickstart + demo script + docker sample (me). I'll include troubleshooting notes and minimal evals.
Eve (Legal): Action list: review messaging + approve marketplace text. Will need a shot of the UI to confirm IP concerns.
Lucy: I'll coordinate cross-team invites and own the launch runway. I'll also request written embargo acknowledgement from Concord.
Concord PM: Sending embargo confirmation + logo package now. Thanks everyone.
Maria: Great. I'll drop the marketplace draft into the board by 2024-08-20 and ping for review. :thumbsup:
Lucy: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for status updates.
